title: AccountEquity (venue equity bases)
description: One venue account's equity report in its own terms. THREE separate bases are kept apart deliberately: spot and futures equity are different measurements of different wallets at one venue, and averaging them would invent a number the venue never published. Any basis the venue does not report is NULL - never 0, never the other basis. Implemented as apps/executor/internal/executor/records.go AccountEquity (*string fields, comment: 'the venue may not report one basis (honest null)').
